description: This file defines an interface ILocalStore for a local storage component within the WPEFramework Plugin namespace. It declares virtual methods for opening storage, creating tables, setting limits, retrieving entries, removing entries, and adding entries.

classes.name: ILocalStore
classes.description: An interface defining methods for interacting with a local storage system, including opening storage, creating tables, managing entries, and retrieving information.

methods.name: Open
methods.description: Opens the storage at the specified path.

methods.name: CreateTable
methods.description: Creates a new table in the storage.

methods.name: SetLimit
methods.description: Sets the limit for entries in a specified table.

methods.name: GetEntriesCount
methods.description: Retrieves the count of entries in a table starting from a specific index with a maximum count.

methods.name: GetEntries
methods.description: Retrieves a list of entries from a table starting from a specific index.

methods.name: RemoveEntries
methods.description: Removes entries in a range from start to end indices in a table.

methods.name: AddEntry
methods.description: Adds a new entry to a specified table.
